data.one_liner: A dialog to pick single or multiple icons with search and customizable icon packs.
data.what_it_does: Provides a dialog widget allowing users to search and select icons from various packs like Material, Cupertino, and FontAwesome. Includes methods to serialize and deserialize selected icons for local or remote storage.
use_when: You need to let users choose icons dynamically within your application.
You want support for standard Material, Cupertino, or custom icon sets with search capabilities.
avoid_when: You do not require user-facing icon selection features.
You want to avoid running a CLI command to generate icon packs on demand.
strengths: Supports multiple icon packs including Material, Cupertino, and FontAwesome.
Provides built-in full-text search and single or multiple icon selection modes.
Includes serialization helpers for database or backend storage.
weaknesses: Requires generating icon packs via a CLI command to keep app sizes small.
Potential for codePoint breakages when updating Flutter versions if using default icons.
data.setup_notes: Requires running a dart CLI command to generate the necessary icon packs on demand, and adding the `--no-tree-shake-icons` flag when building the app.
data.minimal_example: IconPickerIcon? icon = await showIconPicker(context, configuration: SinglePickerConfiguration(iconPackModes: [IconPack.cupertino]));
